metaFile<-read.delim('20240723_metadata_combined.txt', check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

#h3K4me3 peaks

k4me3_peaks_lcl_counts<-read.delim('k4me3_k4Peaks_lcl_deseq_x_normalizedcounts.txt', check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
igg_k4me3_peaks_lcl_counts<-read.delim('prigg_k4Peaks_lcl_deseq_x_normalizedcounts.txt', check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

k4me3_meta<-metaFile[rownames(metaFile) %in% colnames(k4me3_peaks_lcl_counts),]
prigg_meta<-metaFile[rownames(metaFile) %in% colnames(igg_k4me3_peaks_lcl_counts),]

k4me3_peaks_lcl_counts_corrected<-getCorrectedCounts(k4me3_peaks_lcl_counts, k4me3_meta, igg_k4me3_peaks_lcl_counts, prigg_meta, scaleIgG=0.391, useRegion = FALSE)

k4me3_peakList<-read.delim('H3K4me3_consensusPeakset_SAF.txt', check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, header = TRUE)

annoFile<-read.delim("tss1000_condensed_SAF.txt", check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, header=TRUE)
#only want the genes in our list
annoFile_pcg<-read.delim("annotations/pcgSAF.txt", check.names=FALSE,
                         stringsAsFactors = FALSE, header=TRUE)
annoFile<-annoFile[annoFile$Gene%in% annoFile_pcg$GeneID,]
k4me3_peakListAnno<-annotatePeakFile(k4me3_peakList, annoFile)



expInfo<-read.delim("lcl_fib_auto_RNA_response.txt", check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
expGenes_lcl<-expInfo[is.na(expInfo$lcl_baseMean) == FALSE,]$Gene

autosomalPeaks<-k4me3_peakListAnno[k4me3_peakListAnno$Chr !="chrX" & k4me3_peakListAnno$Chr != "chrY",]$PeakID

k4me3_peaks_lcl_counts_corrected$level<-rowMeans(k4me3_peaks_lcl_counts_corrected)/2

peakIDs<-c()
chroms<-c()
levels<-c()
expStatus<-c()
genes<-c()

for (peak in autosomalPeaks) {
  if (peak %in% peakIDs==FALSE) {
    chr<-unique(k4me3_peakListAnno[k4me3_peakListAnno$PeakID==peak,]$Chr)
    level<-k4me3_peaks_lcl_counts_corrected[rownames(k4me3_peaks_lcl_counts_corrected)==peak,]$level
    peakGenes<-k4me3_peakListAnno[k4me3_peakListAnno$PeakID==peak,]$Gene
    for (gene in peakGenes) {
      if (gene %in% expGenes_lcl) {
        exp<-"expressed"
      }
      else {
        exp<-"not expressed"
      }
      peakIDs<-c(peakIDs, peak)
      chroms<-c(chroms, chr)
      levels<-c(levels, level)
      expStatus<-c(expStatus, exp)
      genes<-c(genes, gene)
    }
    
  }
}

autoInfo<-data.frame(PeakID=peakIDs,chr=chroms, level=levels, expressionStatus=expStatus, Gene=genes )
autoInfo$chr<-paste0("chr", autoInfo$chr) #idk why the "chr" got dropped from the chromosome names but I'm adding them back

#get gene categories

peakIDs<-c()
chroms<-c()
levels<-c()
expStatus<-c()
genes<-c()


for (peak in npxPeaks) {
  if (peak %in% peakIDs==FALSE) {
    level<-k4me3_peakLm_X[rownames(k4me3_peakLm_X)==peak,]$x_his_coeff

      genes<-c(genes, gene)
    }

  }
}

XiInfo<-data.frame(PeakID=peakIDs,chr=chroms, level=levels, expressionStatus=expStatus, Gene=genes)
XiInfo$expressionStatus[XiInfo$Gene=="XIST"]<-"Xi-expressed"
XiInfo<-XiInfo[XiInfo$expressionStatus!="no XCI call",]

#Y

oneYdata<-k4me3_peaks_lcl_counts_corrected[,colnames(k4me3_peaks_lcl_counts_corrected) %in% oneYSamps]

#par
peakIDs<-c()
chroms<-c()
levels<-c()
expStatus<-c()
genes<-c()

Par1Peaks<-k4me3_peakListAnno[k4me3_peakListAnno$Gene %in% PAR1_genes,]$PeakID
for (peak in Par1Peaks) {
  xaLevel<-k4me3_peakLm[rownames(k4me3_peakLm)==peak,]$intercept_his
  xiLevel<-k4me3_peakLm[rownames(k4me3_peakLm)==peak,]$x_his_coeff
  yLevel<-k4me3_peakLm[rownames(k4me3_peakLm)==peak,]$y_his_coeff
  peakGenes<-k4me3_peakListAnno[k4me3_peakListAnno$PeakID==peak,]$Gene
  for (gene in peakGenes) {
    if (unique(k4me3_peakLm_X[k4me3_peakLm_X$Gene==gene,]$expStatus_lcl)=="expressed") {
      exp<-"expressed"
    }
    else {
      exp<-"not expressed"
    }
    
    #Xa
    
    peakIDs<-c(peakIDs, peak)
    chroms<-c(chroms, "Xa_PAR")
    levels<-c(levels, xaLevel)
    expStatus<-c(expStatus, exp)
    genes<-c(genes, gene)
    #Xi
    peakIDs<-c(peakIDs, peak)
    chroms<-c(chroms, "Xi_PAR")
    levels<-c(levels, xiLevel)
    expStatus<-c(expStatus, exp)
    genes<-c(genes, gene)
    #Y
    peakIDs<-c(peakIDs, peak)
    chroms<-c(chroms, "Y_PAR")
    levels<-c(levels, yLevel)
    expStatus<-c(expStatus, exp)
    genes<-c(genes, gene)
  }
}

parInfo<-data.frame(PeakID=peakIDs,chr=chroms, level=levels, expressionStatus=expStatus, Gene=genes)

allInfo<-rbind(autoInfo, XaInfo, XiInfo,YInfo, parInfo)
autosomes<-paste0("chr", 1:22)


allInfo$chr<-factor(allInfo$chr, levels=c("Xa_PAR","Xa_NPX", "Xi_PAR", "Xi_NPX", "Y_PAR", "NPY",autosomes))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(ggplot2))
#Consider grouping the two Xa categories, followed by the two Xi categories, followed by the two Y categories.
p1<-ggplot(data=allInfo[allInfo$expressionStatus!="not expressed",], mapping = aes(x=chr, y=level))+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA)+theme_classic()


allInfo$chrName<-as.character(allInfo$chr)
allInfo$chrName[allInfo$chrName %in% c("Xa_PAR","Xa_NPX", "Xi_PAR", "Xi_NPX")]<-"chrX"
allInfo$chrName[allInfo$chrName %in% c("Y_PAR", "NPY")]<-"chrY"

allInfo$newChr<-as.character(allInfo$chr)
for (a in 1:nrow(allInfo)) {
  chrOG<-allInfo[a,]$chrName
  if (chrOG %in% autosomes) {
    newChr<-substr(chrOG, 4, nchar(chrOG))
    allInfo$newChr[a]<-newChr
  }

}

autosomeNums<-as.character(1:22)
allInfo$newChr<-factor(allInfo$newChr, levels=c("Xa_PAR","Xa_NPX", "Xi_PAR", "Xi_NPX", "Y_PAR", "NPY", autosomeNums))

p2<-ggplot(data=allInfo[allInfo$expressionStatus!="not expressed",], mapping = aes(x=newChr, y=level))+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA)+theme_classic()+ylim(NA, 250)+xlab("Chromosome")+ylab("H3K4me3 Level (Promoter Peaks)")+
  theme(axis.text=element_text(size=12), axis.title=element_text(size=12))

expColors<-c("expressed"="white", "not expressed"="gray", "Xi-expressed"="navyblue", "Xi-silent"="red3")

p2.1<-ggplot(data=allInfo[allInfo$expressionStatus!="not expressed",], mapping = aes(x=newChr, y=level, fill=expressionStatus))+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA)+theme_classic()+ylim(NA, 250)+xlab("Chromosome")+ylab("H3K4me3 Level (Promoter Peaks)")+
  theme(axis.text=element_text(size=12), axis.title=element_text(size=12))+scale_fill_manual(values=expColors)


autosome_exp_mean<-mean(allInfo[allInfo$chr %in% c("Xa_PAR","Xa_NPX", "Xi_PAR","Xi_NPX","Y_PAR","NPY") ==FALSE & allInfo$expressionStatus =="expressed",]$level)

autosome_exp_median<-median(allInfo[allInfo$chr %in% c("Xa_PAR","Xa_NPX", "Xi_PAR","Xi_NPX","Y_PAR","NPY") ==FALSE & allInfo$expressionStatus =="expressed",]$level)


for (chromosome in unique(allInfo$chr)) {
  if (chromosome %in% c("Xi_NPX")==FALSE) {
    chromosome_mean<-mean(allInfo[allInfo$chr==chromosome & allInfo$expressionStatus=="expressed",]$level)
    chromosome_median<-median(allInfo[allInfo$chr==chromosome & allInfo$expressionStatus=="expressed",]$level)
    if (chromosome==unique(allInfo$chr)[1]) {
      meanMed_k4<-data.frame(chr=chromosome, k4me3_mean=chromosome_mean,k4me3_median=chromosome_median)
    }
    else {
      newDf<-data.frame(chr=chromosome,  k4me3_mean=chromosome_mean,k4me3_median=chromosome_median)
      meanMed_k4<-rbind(meanMed_k4,newDf)
    }
  }
  else {
    Xi_npx_xiExp_mean<-mean(allInfo[allInfo$chr=="Xi_NPX" & allInfo$expressionStatus=="Xi-expressed",]$level)
    Xi_npx_xiExp_median<-median(allInfo[allInfo$chr=="Xi_NPX" & allInfo$expressionStatus=="Xi-expressed",]$level)
    
    Xi_npx_xiSil_mean<-mean(allInfo[allInfo$chr=="Xi_NPX" & allInfo$expressionStatus=="Xi-silent",]$level)
    Xi_npx_xiSil_median<-median(allInfo[allInfo$chr=="Xi_NPX" & allInfo$expressionStatus=="Xi-silent",]$level)
    
    xiDf<-data.frame(chr=c("Xi_NPX_Xi-Expressed", "Xi_NPX_Xi-silent"), k4me3_mean=c(Xi_npx_xiExp_mean,Xi_npx_xiSil_mean), k4me3_median=c(Xi_npx_xiExp_median,Xi_npx_xiSil_median))
    meanMed_k4<-rbind(meanMed_k4, xiDf)
  }
  
}

autoDf<-data.frame(chr="all_autosomes",  k4me3_mean=autosome_exp_mean, k4me3_median=autosome_exp_median)
meanMed_k4<-rbind(meanMed_k4, autoDf)
#H3K27me3

k27me3_pcg_lcl_counts<-read.delim('k27me3_pcg_lcl_deseq_x_normalizedcounts.txt', check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
migg_pcg_lcl_counts<-read.delim('migg_pcg_lcl_deseq_x_normalizedcounts.txt', check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

metaFile<-read.delim('20240723_metadata_combined.txt', check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

k27me3_meta<-metaFile[rownames(metaFile) %in% colnames(k27me3_pcg_lcl_counts),]
migg_meta<-metaFile[rownames(metaFile) %in% colnames(migg_pcg_lcl_counts),]

k27me3_pcg_lcl_counts_corrected<-getCorrectedCounts(k27me3_pcg_lcl_counts, k27me3_meta, migg_pcg_lcl_counts, migg_meta, scaleIgG=0.108, useRegion = FALSE)


k27me3_lm<-read.delim("lmOutput/corrected/20240917_k27me3_pcg_lcl_lm_xy_minIgG.txt", check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

k27me3_lenNorm<-lenNormal(k27me3_pcg_lcl_counts_corrected,k27me3_lm, "/annotations/pcgSAF.txt")
k27me3_pcg_lcl_counts_lenNorm<-k27me3_lenNorm[1][[1]]
k27me3_lm_lenNorm<-k27me3_lenNorm[2][[1]]

k27me3_lm_lenNorm<-expStatus((k27me3_lm_lenNorm))

pcg_anno<-read.delim("/annotations/pcgSAF.txt", check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, header=TRUE)

expInfo<-read.delim("/genelists/lcl_fib_auto_RNA_response.txt", check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

expGenes_lcl<-expInfo[is.na(expInfo$lcl_log2FC_X)==FALSE,]$Gene

autosomes<-paste0("chr", 1:22)
for (chr in autosomes) {
  chrGenes<-pcg_anno[pcg_anno$Chr==chr,]$GeneID
  chr_df<-k27me3_pcg_lcl_counts_lenNorm[rownames(k27me3_pcg_lcl_counts_lenNorm) %in% chrGenes,]
  chr_df$level<-rowMeans(chr_df)/2
  chr_df$expressionStatus<-"not expressed"
  chr_df$expressionStatus[rownames(chr_df) %in% expGenes_lcl]<-"expressed"
  chr_df$chr<-chr
  chr_df<-chr_df[, colnames(chr_df) %in% c("level", "expressionStatus",  "chr")]
  if (chr=="chr1") {
    autosome_df<-chr_df
  }
  else {
    autosome_df<-rbind(autosome_df, chr_df)
  }
}
autosome_df$Gene<-rownames(autosome_df)

oneX_samples<-rownames(metaFile[metaFile$x_count==1,])
counts_oneX<-k27me3_pcg_lcl_counts_lenNorm[,colnames(k27me3_pcg_lcl_counts_lenNorm) %in% oneX_samples]
counts_oneX$level<-rowMeans(counts_oneX)

Xa_levels<-c()
Xa_status<-c()
Xi_levels<-c()
Xi_status<-c()
genes<-c()
for (gene in NPX_genes) {
  if (gene %in% rownames(k27me3_lm_lenNorm)) {
    xalevel<-counts_oneX[rownames(counts_oneX)==gene,]$level
    xaExp<-k27me3_lm_lenNorm[rownames(k27me3_lm_lenNorm)==gene,]$xaExp_lcl
    if (xaExp=="on") {
      xaExp<-"expressed"
    }
    else {
      xaExp<-"not expressed"
    }
    xiLevel<-k27me3_lm_lenNorm[rownames(k27me3_lm_lenNorm)==gene,]$x_his_coeff
    xiExp<-k27me3_lm_lenNorm[rownames(k27me3_lm_lenNorm)==gene,]$xciStatus_lcl
    Xa_levels<-c(Xa_levels, xalevel)
    Xa_status<-c(Xa_status, xaExp)
    Xi_levels<-c(Xi_levels, xiLevel)
    Xi_status<-c(Xi_status, xiExp)
    genes<-c(genes,gene)
  }
  
}

xa_info<-data.frame(level=Xa_levels, expressionStatus=Xa_status, chr="Xa_NPX", Gene=genes)
xi_info<-data.frame(level=Xi_levels, expressionStatus=Xi_status, chr="Xi_NPX", Gene=genes)


oneY_samples<-rownames(metaFile[metaFile$y_count==1,])
counts_oneY<-k27me3_pcg_lcl_counts_lenNorm[,colnames(k27me3_pcg_lcl_counts_lenNorm) %in% oneY_samples]
counts_oneY$level<-rowMeans(counts_oneY)


y_levels<-c()
y_status<-c()
genes<-c()

for (gene in NPY_genes) {
  if (gene %in% rownames(k27me3_lm_lenNorm)) {
    level<-counts_oneY[rownames(counts_oneY)==gene,]$level
    exp<-k27me3_lm_lenNorm[rownames(k27me3_lm_lenNorm)==gene,]$expStatus_lcl
    y_levels<-c(y_levels, level)
    y_status<-c(y_status, exp)
    genes<-c(genes,gene)
  }
}

y_info<-data.frame(level=y_levels, expressionStatus=y_status, chr="NPY", Gene=genes)

#Par
xaParLevels<-c()
xiParLevels<-c()
yParLevels<-c()
expStatus<-c()
genes<-c()

for (gene in PAR1_genes) {
  xaLevel<-k27me3_lm_lenNorm[rownames(k27me3_lm_lenNorm)==gene,]$intercept_his
  xiLevel<-k27me3_lm_lenNorm[rownames(k27me3_lm_lenNorm)==gene,]$x_his_coeff
  yLevel<-k27me3_lm_lenNorm[rownames(k27me3_lm_lenNorm)==gene,]$y_his_coeff

xaPar<-data.frame(level=xaParLevels, expressionStatus=expStatus, chr="Xa_PAR", Gene=genes)
xiPar<-data.frame(level=xiParLevels, expressionStatus=expStatus, chr="Xi_PAR", Gene=genes)
yPar<-data.frame(level=yParLevels, expressionStatus=expStatus, chr="Y_PAR", Gene=genes)

k27me3_allInfo<-rbind(autosome_df,xa_info,xi_info,y_info,xaPar,xiPar,yPar)
k27me3_allInfo<-k27me3_allInfo[k27me3_allInfo$expressionStatus!="no XCI call",]
k27me3_allInfo$expressionStatus[k27me3_allInfo$Gene=="XIST" & k27me3_allInfo$chr=="Xi_NPX"]<-"Xi-expressed"

k27me3_allInfo$chr<-factor(k27me3_allInfo$chr, levels=c("Xa_PAR","Xa_NPX", "Xi_PAR", "Xi_NPX", "Y_PAR", "NPY",autosomes))

p3<-ggplot(data=k27me3_allInfo[k27me3_allInfo$expressionStatus!="not expressed",], mapping = aes(x=chr, y=level))+

k27me3_allInfo$chrName<-as.character(k27me3_allInfo$chr)
k27me3_allInfo$chrName[k27me3_allInfo$chrName %in% c("Xa_PAR","Xa_NPX", "Xi_PAR", "Xi_NPX")]<-"chrX"
k27me3_allInfo$chrName[k27me3_allInfo$chrName %in% c("Y_PAR", "NPY")]<-"chrY"

k27me3_allInfo$newChr<-as.character(k27me3_allInfo$chr)
for (a in 1:nrow(k27me3_allInfo)) {
  chrOG<-k27me3_allInfo[a,]$chrName
  if (chrOG %in% autosomes) {
    newChr<-substr(chrOG, 4, nchar(chrOG))
    k27me3_allInfo$newChr[a]<-newChr
  }
  
}

k27me3_allInfo$newChr<-factor(k27me3_allInfo$newChr, levels=c("Xa_PAR","Xa_NPX", "Xi_PAR", "Xi_NPX", "Y_PAR", "NPY", autosomeNums))

p4<-ggplot(data=k27me3_allInfo[k27me3_allInfo$expressionStatus!="not expressed",], mapping = aes(x=newChr, y=level))+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA)+theme_classic()+ylim(NA, 5)+xlab("Chromosome")+ylab("H3K27me3 Level Gene Body)")+
  theme(axis.text=element_text(size=12), axis.title=element_text(size=12))


p4.1<-ggplot(data=k27me3_allInfo[k27me3_allInfo$expressionStatus!="not expressed",], mapping = aes(x=newChr, y=level, fill=expressionStatus))+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA)+theme_classic()+ylim(NA, 4.5)+xlab("Chromosome")+ylab("H3K27me3 Level Gene Body)")+
  theme(axis.text=element_text(size=12), axis.title=element_text(size=12))+scale_fill_manual(values=expColors)



autosome_exp_mean<-mean(k27me3_allInfo[k27me3_allInfo$chr %in% c("Xa_PAR","Xa_NPX", "Xi_PAR","Xi_NPX","Y_PAR","NPY") ==FALSE & k27me3_allInfo$expressionStatus =="expressed",]$level)

autosome_exp_median<-median(k27me3_allInfo[k27me3_allInfo$chr %in% c("Xa_PAR","Xa_NPX", "Xi_PAR","Xi_NPX","Y_PAR","NPY") ==FALSE & k27me3_allInfo$expressionStatus =="expressed",]$level)


for (chromosome in unique(k27me3_allInfo$chr)) {
  if (chromosome %in% c("Xi_NPX")==FALSE) {
    chromosome_mean<-mean(k27me3_allInfo[k27me3_allInfo$chr==chromosome & k27me3_allInfo$expressionStatus=="expressed",]$level)
    chromosome_median<-median(k27me3_allInfo[k27me3_allInfo$chr==chromosome & k27me3_allInfo$expressionStatus=="expressed",]$level)
    if (chromosome==unique(k27me3_allInfo$chr)[1]) {
      meanMed_k27<-data.frame(chr=chromosome, k27me3_mean=chromosome_mean,k27me3_median=chromosome_median)
    }
    else {
      newDf<-data.frame(chr=chromosome,  k27me3_mean=chromosome_mean,k27me3_median=chromosome_median)
      meanMed_k27<-rbind(meanMed_k27,newDf)
    }
  }
  else {
    Xi_npx_xiExp_mean<-mean(k27me3_allInfo[k27me3_allInfo$chr=="Xi_NPX" & k27me3_allInfo$expressionStatus=="Xi-expressed",]$level)
    Xi_npx_xiExp_median<-median(k27me3_allInfo[k27me3_allInfo$chr=="Xi_NPX" & k27me3_allInfo$expressionStatus=="Xi-expressed",]$level)
    
    Xi_npx_xiSil_mean<-mean(k27me3_allInfo[k27me3_allInfo$chr=="Xi_NPX" & k27me3_allInfo$expressionStatus=="Xi-silent",]$level)
    Xi_npx_xiSil_median<-median(k27me3_allInfo[k27me3_allInfo$chr=="Xi_NPX" & k27me3_allInfo$expressionStatus=="Xi-silent",]$level)
    
    xiDf<-data.frame(chr=c("Xi_NPX_Xi-Expressed", "Xi_NPX_Xi-silent"), k27me3_mean=c(Xi_npx_xiExp_mean,Xi_npx_xiSil_mean), k27me3_median=c(Xi_npx_xiExp_median,Xi_npx_xiSil_median))
    meanMed_k27<-rbind(meanMed_k27, xiDf)
  }
  
}

autoDf<-data.frame(chr="all_autosomes",  k27me3_mean=autosome_exp_mean, k27me3_median=autosome_exp_median)
meanMed_k27<-rbind(meanMed_k27, autoDf)

ordrow<-match(meanMed_k27$chr, meanMed_k4$chr)
meanMed_k4_k27<-cbind(meanMed_k4[ordrow,], meanMed_k27[,colnames(meanMed_k27) !="chr"] )

library(patchwork)
p2.2<-p2.1+theme(axis.title.x=element_blank(), axis.line.x = element_blank(), axis.text.x=element_blank(), axis.ticks.x=element_blank())
finalFigure <- wrap_plots(list(p2.2,p4.1),ncol = 1)
